description: Read resolved and pending permission requests and current permission grants. Read-only; does not change permissions or approve actions.

permissions.history.description: Read resolved permission requests as Markdown (newest first), or look up one pending/resolved request by approval_id.

permissions.list_active.description: List current permission settings and grants, including scope and expiry.

permissions.list_pending.description: List permission requests currently waiting for the user (newest first, max 20 per page; follow next_cursor).
